name: Twilio
tagline: Programmable voice, SMS, video, and messaging APIs for global communication
description: Twilio provides cloud communications APIs that let developers send and receive SMS, make and receive phone calls, build video and chat experiences, and orchestrate omnichannel messaging (WhatsApp, email, etc.) with programmable webhooks and SDKs.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with Account SID as username and Auth Token (or API Key SID + Secret) as password. Account SID and Auth Token from the Console; API Keys preferred for production.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 30-day free trial with product-specific free units (not a ~$15 dollar balance): e.g. 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 75 voice minutes, 3,000 emails. Restrictions: verified recipients only (up to 5), sign-up country only, pre-defined templates. No unlimited free production quota — pay-as-you-go after upgrade.
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go SMS/voice/etc. by country and channel; volume discounts and committed-use plans available.

rate_limits: Not a single global limit; product-specific concurrent and request limits (e.g. messaging throughput varies by number type/country). See Twilio rate limits docs.
use_cases: send an SMS or MMS to a phone number
make or receive programmable voice calls
verify a user phone number with OTP/2FA
look up phone number carrier and type
